preconditions.name: vs_tracking_live
preconditions.description: READINESS: region-V_s tracking must be live (per_stream_vs populated), else region_vs is the degenerate constant-1.0 fallback and low_vs_steps=0 is a substrate artefact not an env finding. Worst-cell max streams tracked during measurement.
preconditions.control: worst cell (min over cells of max streams tracked)

preconditions.name: off_forward_pe_varies
preconditions.description: READINESS positive control: OFF-arm committed-trajectory forward PE must have non-zero variance (world_forward learned something on the escalated-dose env). SAME statistic the elevation disambiguation reads. Worst ARM_0 cell variance.

preconditions.name: off_forward_pe_bounded
preconditions.description: READINESS: forward PE bounded (no explosion / NaN). Worst ARM_0 cell mean.
